reviews.author: sumitkamboj
reviews.text: Replies: 0 Rating: 5 stars Webnotics CRO Audit is a really useful plugin for anyone looking to improve their online store’s conversion rate. What I particularly like is how it reviews selected store pages from a shopper’s perspective and highlights potential issues that could prevent customers from completing a purchase. Overall, I appreciate the straightforward approach and the focus on actionable improvements rather than just providing generic suggestions. A great tool for store owners who want to identify usability issues, improve the shopping experience, and make their store more conversion-friendly.
